title: Profiling of individual through health data analysis
description: The companion app may analyze calorie, meal, and weight data to create health profiles or patterns about the user, potentially linking this data to other datasets.

title: Processing of identified health data
description: The system requests and processes identified personal data (calorie intake, meals, weight) which can be used to identify or profile the user.

title: Revealing attributes in health data
description: The data collected (calories, meals, weight) contains revealing attributes about the user's health status, lifestyle, and potentially sensitive medical information.

title: Data attribution for health claims
description: The logged data can be used to prevent the user from denying certain health-related claims or activities.

title: Detection through observed data flow
description: The data flow of user health entries could be observed by third parties or system monitoring.

title: Sensitive health data type sensitivity
description: Calorie, meal, and weight data are sensitive personal health information that should only be collected when strictly required for the app's functionality.

title: Excessive volume of health data
description: The amount of personal health data processed may exceed what is functionally needed for the companion app's core functionality.

title: Unnecessary treatment and analysis of health data
description: Personal health data may be further treated, analyzed, or enriched in ways not necessary to achieve the app's basic functionality.

title: Unawareness of health data processing
description: The user may not be fully aware of how their calorie, meal, and weight data is being processed, stored, or disclosed beyond the app's intended use.

title: Lack of control over health data processing preferences
description: The user may lack control over how their personal health data is processed, stored, or shared with third parties.

title: Violation of data minimization principle
description: More personal health data may be processed than is actually needed for the companion app's functional goals.

title: Insufficient data subject controls for health data
description: Support for data subject rights regarding health data (access, rectification, erasure) may be lacking.

title: Health data quasi-identifier combination
description: Calorie intake, weight history, and exercise session data combined can serve as quasi-identifiers that could link health logs to specific individuals

title: Revealing attributes in health logs
description: Health logs contain revealing attributes (weight, calorie intake, exercise patterns) that support identification of the data subject

title: Sensitive health data type sensitivity
description: Health data (calorie intake, weight, exercise) is highly sensitive and should only be collected when strictly required for the app's functionality

description: Health logs may contain more personal data than functionally needed for the companion app's core functionality
